item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.2.0

  • Personalities: sleepy, playful, clingy, shy, mischievous or chatty, with a default temperament per breed
  • Laser pointer: a red dot follows your cursor and the cat goes after it
  • Accessories now work on the illustrated breeds too, not just the Classic cat
  • The cat photographer: it pulls out a camera, counts down and takes a polaroid of you, collected in a Selfie Diary (off by default)
  • The Turkish Angora's sleeping frames were drawn facing the wrong way; fixed

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.1.0

  • Seven cats: Classic plus six illustrated breeds (Ginger, Turkish Van, Turkish Angora, British Shorthair, Siamese, Black Cat)
  • Personalities: sleepy, playful, clingy, shy, mischievous or chatty, with a default per breed
  • Sims-style needs with a mood diamond and thought bubbles
  • Water bowl and litter box you can drag anywhere
  • The cat climbs your windows and teases the close button
  • Automatic updates
